component.name: Maze of Galious
component.summary: Remake of Konami's MSX platformer The Maze of Galious

description.p: Maze of Galious Remake is an unofficial, not-for-profit remake of Konami's The Maze of Galious (Knightmare II), released in 1987 for the MSX. Guide Popolon and Aphrodite through the castle and its ten worlds, defeat the demons and rescue their child. Made by Brain Games, with several graphic and sound sets to choose from.

ul.li: Gamepad players can now say a demon's name: LB/RB in the demon's room opens a letter picker (Tab on the keyboard)
Memory fixes found with AddressSanitizer (item screen in the castle, graphic set changes, demon fights)

description.p: SDL3 port of the Maze of Galious remake v0.63, packaged for Linux.

ul.li: Title screen menu: PLAY START, PASSWORD (continue a saved game, also with a gamepad) and OPTIONS
OPTIONS menu: music and effects volume, sound set, graphic set, fullscreen, window size, filter and controls
Gamepad support with hot-plug; gamepads also navigate the menus
Upscaling filters: Scale2x, 2xSaI, hq2x, xBR, OmniScale and Lanczos
